decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the north and south elevation shall be obscure glazed,  and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 7A Cromwell Street.
description: Erection of a two storey and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
